description_en: The DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus operation queries the health status of the origin server for a DCDN-accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus查询DCDN加速域名的源站运行状态
name: DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. Only one domain name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 您的加速域名，仅支持单个域名设置
parameters.name: domain_name

OriginSiteStatus.description_en: A list of health statuses for the origin servers of the accelerated domain name
OriginSiteStatus.description_zh: 加速域名对应的源站运行情况列表

HealthStatus.description_en:
DCDN nodes periodically send probe requests to your origin domain name. A probe is successful if a response is received from the origin server within 5 seconds. The health status of the origin server is calculated based on the success rate of these probes across all nodes. The health statuses are described as follows:

unknown: The probe data for the origin server could not be obtained. This happens because the configuration of the origin server was recently changed. Retry later.

healthy: The probe success rate is higher than 80%.

degraded: The probe success rate is greater than 0% but less than or equal to 80%.

critical: All probe requests to the origin server failed
HealthStatus.description_zh:
DCDN的各个节点会定期对您配置的源站域名发起探测请求，若在5秒之内收到源站响应则认为探测成功。通过汇总各个节点的探测数据，根据成功比例计算出源站的运行状态。各个运行状态的说明如下：
unknown（未知）：未能获取到对应源站的探测数据，这是由于该源站的配置短期内发生过变更，请您稍后重试。
healthy（健康）：成功探测的比例高于80%。
degraded（部分健康）：成功探测的比例小于等于80%，但高于0%。
critical（异常）：对该源站的所有探测请求均失败

Host.description_en: The origin domain name that you configured in the DCDN console. This can be an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address, a generic domain name, or an OSS domain name
Host.description_zh: 您在DCDN控制台上配置的源站域名，包括IPv4地址、IPv6地址、普通域名、OSS域名
